0022600229.text: The Timberwolves (8-3, on a four-game win streak and 7-3 in their last ten) host the Mavericks (6-4, on a two-game win streak and 6-4 in their last ten) in Minnesota's 12th game of the season, and Minnesota will be without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery). Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Morez Johnson Jr. (leg), Sergio de Larrea (knee, strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel, inflammation). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Minnesota won all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 124-94 in Dallas on March 30, 2026.
